newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales unchanged - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales unchanged - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales were unchanged in the week ended March 22 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.7 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 1.3 percent from the prior month.
The report which is normally embargoed for 0900 EST/1400 GMT was released early by other news services.
